column5: The bench is spoken for. Bell will send you when it matters.
Not now, Captain. I have a tavern to keep and no time for strangers.
Harbour business is for captains with a ship's business. Come back when you have some.
Keep walking. I wear the wrong coat to be seen talking to a pirate who has not earned the reach.
The mud has not learned your footsteps. Speak to Ada Kell before you bring your troubles to my door.
